page.overview:
Who is Allara?

Allara was a female Human Jedi Initiate who studied in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive female Human, Allara was a member of the Jedi Order, strong in the Force and a firm believer in the Jedi Code. Having trained at the Order's academy for years as a member of the Bergruutfa Clan, Allara and her peers were still quite young when the Clone Wars erupted across the galaxy. In an unorthodox move, Jedi Master Quarmall abducted the clan in 20 BBY and declared that each member was his Padawan. Traveling aboard a Mon Calamari starship along with her clan and new master, their ship was attacked while in transit by General Grievous and a Separatist fleet. With its engines heavily damaged, the crew could do nothing but defend their ship. Despite their efforts, the Mon Calamari crew were cut down by boarding parties of B1-Series battle droids, with Grievous following close behind.

Quarmall destroyed many of the droids who attacked him, but he was eventually surrounded and confronted by Grievous. The general discussed the possibility of dueling Quarmall, but claimed that he had grown tired of killing Jedi and ordered him killed by the droids instead. The droids turned their weapons on him and blasted the Jedi, seemingly killing him—unknown to all, Quarmall had survived, but would not resurface until years later. Grievous was brought further into the ship by his droids, stepping over the bodies of fallen Mon Calamari on the way. There he found a closed room, and within it, Allara and her fellow Padawans, including Banz and Tak-tak. Grievous ignited his lightsaber and took the Padawans as captives.

Soon after, Grievous and the Trade Federation conquered the planet of Gentes and its moon, Belsus. After a brief and one-sided battle, the native Ugnaughts were captured and forced to convert their own factories for use by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Padawans arrived on Belsus aboard a C-9979 landing craft, with B1's guarding them closely. Though the other Padawans worried over their fate, Allara was stoic about their situation, and Banz told the others to bury their fear and face the future with courage. The younglings were then brought to meet Grievous once more, on a balcony overlooking the city. Grievous then informed them that they were to become warriors for him, trying to convince them that this fate was not that different than that of being a Jedi. Allara, however, knew that this meant they would become servants of the Sith, and told the cyborg they would never do so.
